rationale: Empirical lens, round 2 at ada49e53 (worktree HEAD verified, left byte-identical, git status clean). My round-1 ask (G1, flag-blind fallback) is ADDRESSED, verified by re-running every round-1 repro against a freshly built binary: `--spec 999` with one draft present now refuses non-zero by name ('no spec found matching prefix "999"') instead of the round-1 exit-0 misattribution of a different spec; `--spec 999` with zero drafts refuses; `--spec ../evil` refuses at validation; and `--spec 999-bogus-spec` (valid-format, nonexistent full ID — my round-1 F2, which I had classified pre-existing/backlog) now also refuses by name ('no active spec or draft found for 999-bogus-spec'), a bonus beyond my ask. No ambient behavior regressed: single draft -> mode:spec exit 0; two drafts -> ErrAmbiguousTarget listing both, exit 1; zero drafts -> bare idle; bd dead -> non-zero refusal; `--spec <full-id>` still targets one of two drafts. The four new G1 regression fixtures (FlagBlind_UnresolvableSpecWithOneDraft, FlagBlind_UnresolvableSpecWithNoDrafts, FlagBlind_InvalidSpecValue, FlaggedNonexistentSpec) all pass, including under -race. G2 verified with a stateful flaky-bd stub (first call fails, rest serve a real in_progress epic with mindspec_phase plan): round-2 binary renders mode:plan on both the ambient and flagged paths, while the round-1 binary on the identical fixture fabricated bare {"mode":"idle"} over a live epic — the hard-block class, empirically demonstrated fixed. G3 hand-probed with the REAL spec-create shape (git worktree add -b spec/130-branch-only-draft, commit the spec dir only inside that worktree, worktree remove; main working tree confirmed to NOT contain the dir): round-2 binary from main renders {"mode":"spec","activeSpec":"130-branch-only-draft"}, round-1 binary on the same fixture said bare idle; --spec full-ID targeting works and bd-dead still refuses on that fixture. FileExistsAtRef's documented cat-file -e caveat (exit 128 for both absent-path and absent-ref, hence branch-confirmation-first ordering) matches its use: the tree probe only runs after BranchExistsIn. Precision of the tree probe confirmed by the half-draft fixture: a spec branch whose tree contains a DIFFERENT spec's dir is not misread as a draft of the branch's own spec (candidate paths are specID-scoped); dir-only and branch-only-without-content half-drafts still derive honest idle; unreadable specs dir still refuses; dir+branch+epic still defers to bd's derived phase. {"mode":""} exit 0 remains dead on every path I could construct (all-fail bd -> refusal; DerivePhaseFromChildren can never return empty; instruct's G4 call site now falls back to handleNoState on modeErr instead of passing an empty mode to Render). Suites green from the bead worktree: go build ./..., internal/resolve, internal/gitutil, internal/instruct, internal/lint (both new ratchet entries accepted), internal/phase, cmd/mindspec -short; state-show and resolve draft tests green under -race. One residual minor finding (F4, pre-existing, non-blocking) below.

findings.summary: Round-1 flag-blind propagation ask fully fixed and regression-pinned. An explicit --spec that fails resolution propagates the resolution error after the warm-cache retry (never ambient draft/idle, never another spec's draft), and a flagged spec deriving genuine idle refuses by name instead of rendering idle+activeSpec. All four repro shapes re-run empirically at ada49e53: unresolvable prefix with one draft, with zero drafts, invalid value, valid-format nonexistent full ID — all refuse non-zero by name. The prefix form `--spec 031` with two matching drafts now refuses honestly ('no spec found matching prefix') rather than resolving the draft by prefix — the minimal honest disposition I offered in round 1; prefix targeting of drafts would be a UX extension, not an honesty gap.

PRE-EXISTING residue, non-blocking, recommend routing to bead 5 or a follow-up bead: a ghost spec worktree (a directory named .worktrees/worktree-spec-131-ghost containing a repo with NO spec dir, NO spec/131-ghost branch, NO epic) still renders {"mode":"idle","activeSpec":"131-ghost","specBranch":"spec/131-ghost"} exit 0 from the ambient path — idle alongside a non-empty activeSpec. Verified identical on the pre-bead parent binary and the round-1 binary, so this commit did not introduce it; the realistic route to the shape is spec create crashing after worktree add but before the draft commit, or a draft abandoned by deleting branch+dir while leaving the worktree. However, the new state.go comment above the flagged-idle refusal asserts 'a worktree-derived spec ID always probes to at least spec mode' — that invariant claim is falsified by this constructible fixture, so the comment over-claims even though the guarded behavior change itself is correct. Suggested disposition: extend the by-name refusal (or drop to bare idle without activeSpec) for the worktree-derived no-epic-no-draft case, and correct the comment, wherever bead 5 touches these paths.

Judgment call A unchanged from my round 1: SUPPORT. Round 2 strengthens it — the single-cache specID-sourced derivation now also powers the G2 warm-cache retry, and explicit --spec targeting of one of two drafts (which the literal ctx.Phase substitution would have regressed) re-verified working at ada49e53.
